overview.text: The pelvic girdle (hip girdle) is formed by a single bone, the hip bone or coxal bone (coxal = “hip”), which serves as the attachment point for each lower limb.
overview.label: 8.3 The Pelvic Girdle and Pelvis

overview.text: Each hip bone, in turn, is firmly joined to the axial skeleton via its attachment to the sacrum of the vertebral column.
overview.label: 8.3 The Pelvic Girdle and Pelvis

overview.text: The right and left hip bones also converge anteriorly to attach to each other.
overview.label: 8.3 The Pelvic Girdle and Pelvis
